title: Weighted multiplication columns give the product
statement:
Let $a,b$ be finite bit strings and let $n$ be a natural number with $|a|+|b|\le n$. If $C_j(a,b)=\sum_{p=0}^{|a|-1}[p\le j]a_p b_{j-p}$, with out-of-range bits taken to be zero, then
\[\sum_{j=0}^{n-1}2^j C_j(a,b)=V(a)V(b),\]
where $V(w)=\sum_{i=0}^{|w|-1}2^i w_i$.
